**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Madam
I am much obliged for your great kindness in allowing [my mother](../persons.html#1606) and myself the perusal of the enclosed valuable letter. I have been from home for some days, or I would sooner have returned it, and expressed our best thanks for the favour of its perusal
yours much obliged

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Probably dating between the death of WCY and the death of the Rev.

Charles Dyson in 1860.
